rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides integration with LoadRunner Cloud's performance testing platform through nine specialized tools for managing load tests and analyzing performance data. Built by Postman Inc., this implementation offers complete workflow coverage from project discovery to detailed test execution analysis, including active test run monitoring, transaction analysis, HTTP response inspection, and recent license usage tracking. The server uses OAuth client credentials authentication with environment variable configuration and includes comprehensive error handling with structured JSON responses, making it valuable for DevOps teams running automated performance testing pipelines, QA engineers analyzing load test results, and development teams monitoring application performance metrics across LoadRunner Cloud test executions.
